title: Motion Design Artist for Video Production Agency (Full-Time Only)
description:
We're looking for an Motion Design Artist with Strong Specialty in After Effects to join Jeong X. This is a hands-on After Effects + motion design role working alongside our team of editors — your job is to use your creativity to create visuals that tell the story and elevate the educational and narrative value of every video we produce. 



From Netflix-level documentaries to high-performing YouTube videos, you'll design and animate the graphics, motion, and new assets that turn a solid cut into a premium, polished piece. If you love the craft of designing and animating in AE — creating new assets from scratch, 3D camera work, compositing, and finishing — this role is built for you.



APPLY HERE: 



## What you'll build — a few examples



These aren't the whole job — they're a sense of the kinds of assets you'll create. Day to day, you'll use your own eye and creativity to design visuals that carry the story and make each video clearer and more engaging:



1. **Designed visual containers** — designing and building frames and containers in After Effects that hold lower-resolution or archival footage, so it sits cleanly in a Netflix-level piece. The footage should feel intentional and designed, never like a low-res clip dropped on screen.

2. **Animated maps** — one of the more complex and important builds. Designing and animating map sequences with 3D camera moves, detailed keyframing, and multi-layer compositions that guide the viewer through locations and journeys. Comfort designing in 3D space, camera animation, and layered comps in AE is essential.

3. **Tilt-shift & blur maps** — creating custom depth-of-field / tilt-shift and blur passes scene by scene. Each scene gets its own blur map, so this takes a careful, consistent eye and real patience for detail across many shots.



Beyond examples like these, you'll design and animate whatever a piece needs to tell its story well — titles, lower-thirds, transitions, custom graphic elements — always in service of the story and the viewer's understanding.



## What we're looking for (required)



- Deep After Effects skill with a real motion design sensibility — designing and animating new assets, 3D camera and keyframe animation, multi-layer compositions, compositing, and finishing.

- A storyteller's instinct — you use visuals to make ideas clearer and more engaging, elevating the educational and narrative value of a video rather than just decorating it.

- Direct experience animating maps or complex 3D-camera sequences in AE. Point us to examples in your reel.

- A premium, cinematic eye — you understand what makes motion design and footage read as "high-end" versus amateur.

- A good sense of sound design — you understand how sound and motion work together, and how audio lifts the quality of VFX and motion graphics. You won't be the sole audio person, but this sensibility matters.

- After Effects + motion design experience across both social / YouTube and long-form work (show us both).

- Precision and patience for repetitive, detail-critical work (like per-scene blur maps) without the quality slipping.

- Able to work remotely alongside an editor — take direction, turn notes around quickly, and hit deadlines.

- A portfolio or reel that demonstrates the above (link required).



## Nice to have



- 3D beyond AE — Cinema 4D, Blender, or Element 3D.

- Compositing depth: tracking, rotoscoping, keying, and cleanup.

- Strong design chops — comfortable creating assets in Photoshop and Illustrator.

- Sound design or audio editing experience.

- Familiarity with Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve for hand-off with our editor.

- Experience in a documentary, film, or long-form / YouTube environment.



## Tools you'll use



Adobe After Effects (primary — this is 90% of the role), plus Premiere Pro / Photoshop / Illustrator; 3D tools (Cinema 4D / Blender / Element 3D) a strong plus.

title: Amazon Catalog & Listing Specialist (Flat Files), Premium & Heritage Brands
description:
We are an established Amazon agency (20+ years) managing premium and heritage brands in categories like tabletop, glassware, home, and gift. Many of these brands are older companies whose product data was built for retail, not for Amazon, so it arrives incomplete and messy. We are hiring an experienced catalog specialist to take that data and get it live, accurate, and fully indexed on Amazon at scale.

This role is a fit if you have several years of hands-on experience building and fixing Amazon listings through flat files across large catalogs, and you are current on how Amazon search and indexing work today. If your experience is editing listings one at a time in the Seller Central interface, and you have not worked with flat files at scale, this is not the right role for you.

What the role involves:



Taking brand product data and getting it live correctly: right category, right flat file template, valid values, titles, bullets, backend, images mapped

Bulk uploads and error triage across catalogs with thousands of SKUs

Diagnosing and fixing de-indexed, suppressed, and buy-box-suppressed listings

Verifying that backend changes actually propagate to the live listing, and resolving it when they do not

Keeping catalog and pricing data clean in SellerCloud

Reading and maintaining SOPs



Requirements:



Multiple years building and fixing Amazon listings via flat files, with real examples you can show

Strong command of category templates, valid values, bulk uploads, and error troubleshooting at scale

Current understanding of how Amazon search works now, including Rufus and Cosmo and semantic indexing

Experience with large or messy catalogs and incomplete source data is a major plus

Familiarity with tools such as Seller Central, FlatFile Pro, SellerCloud or a similar ERP, ChannelMax or other repricers, Helium 10, and Excel

Reliable, consistent daily hours with some overlap with US Eastern Time

ClickUp for tasks and time tracking (we will train you)



How to apply (we screen carefully, applications that skip these steps are not reviewed):



Start your subject line with the word TANGIER.

Answer these three questions in your own words, briefly and specifically. We are judging how you think, and generic or AI-written answers are easy to spot.



a. A listing has had zero impressions for a full month. What is the first thing you check, and why?



b. What are Rufus and Cosmo, and how have they changed the way you fill out a flat file? If you have not worked with them yet, say so, and tell me how you would get up to speed.



c. Describe one specific listing or catalog problem you fixed: what was wrong, how you found it, what you did, and the result. One short paragraph.



d. what are the latest Amazon Title guidelines and what does a good title like for a heritage brand?

 

Optional, but it helps: attach a flat file you have built or a screenshot of a bulk-upload error you resolved.

Include your CV.

A $90 hand-finished ceramic bowl can look identical to a $15 one on screen. The job is making a shopper understand the price difference through the images alone. If your portfolio is mostly text-heavy feature infographics for commodity products, this is not the right role.

What the role involves:



Full image sets: main image, lifestyle and in-context shots, feature and scale callouts, collection cross-sell, and branding and proof images (stamps, gift boxes, made-in, designer, patents, warranty)

A+ content and storefront visuals

Video, including AI-assisted editing of human-shot footage, with correct scale and no artifacts

Researching each brand before designing so the work matches the brand's tone and the real reasons customers buy

Iterating on creative based on performance, customer questions, and competitor benchmarks

Following brand guidelines and license restrictions (some licenses prohibit AI-generated visuals)



Requirements:



Several years of hands-on Amazon image and A+ design with a portfolio you can show

Experience with premium or design-forward products, not just feature callout infographics

Competence with AI image and video tools combined with clear judgment about where they fall short

Familiarity with Amazon image and video technical requirements

ClickUp for tasks and time tracking (we will train you)

Consistent daily hours with some overlap with US Eastern Time



How to apply (applications that skip these steps are not reviewed):



Start your subject line with the word MONTAUK.

Include a portfolio link. Point specifically to one Amazon listing or image set you designed for a premium or higher-priced product and tell me in two or three sentences what you were trying to achieve with it.

Answer these three questions in your own words. Generic or AI-written answers are easy to identify and will not be considered.



a. We sell a $90 hand-finished ceramic serving bowl from a heritage brand. In a flat photo it looks like any other bowl. How do you design the image set so a shopper understands why it is worth far more than a $15 version?



b. How do you use AI image and video tools in your work, and where do they fall short for premium products? Give one specific thing you would not trust AI to handle.

title: Expert Supply Chain Manager
description:
VogueNow is a growing skincare brand selling across the US, UK, Canada and Europe through Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop and other sales channels. We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain & Inventory Manager to take ownership of our global supply chain—from demand forecasting and purchasing through production, freight, inventory control and final marketplace delivery. Right inventory. Right market. Right time. Right cost and quality.



Key Responsibilities

- Own demand forecasting and inventory planning across Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop and other sales channels.

- Maintain healthy inventory levels while reducing stockouts, excess stock, ageing inventory and storage costs.

- Create purchase orders based on forecasts, lead times, safety stock, supplier capacity and cash-flow plans.

- Manage suppliers, production schedules, pricing, quantities, timelines and payment requirements.

Coordinate product inspections and resolve quality issues before inventory is shipped.

- Manage freight from supplier pickup through customs, warehouses, Amazon FBA and final inventory receipt.

- Compare freight options based on cost, speed and operational risk.

Investigate lost, damaged, short-received or incorrectly processed inventory and recover reimbursements.

- Coordinate with Marketing, Product, Finance and Brand Operations on launches, promotions and demand changes.

- Build and improve supply-chain SOPs, trackers, dashboards and automations.

- Provide weekly updates and monthly reporting on inventory health, supplier performance, logistics costs and key risks.



Eligibility Requirements

You must have:

- At least 3 years of professional experience in supply chain, inventory planning, purchasing, logistics or a closely related role.

- Experience managing supply chain for a physical-product or e-commerce business.

- Strong knowledge of forecasting, safety stock, reorder points, lead times and inventory planning.

- Experience managing suppliers, purchase orders, production and international freight.

- Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills.



Who Will Succeed in This Role

- Fast but detail-oriented: You move quickly without creating costly mistakes.

- An owner: You take responsibility for outcomes, not just assigned tasks.

- Proactive: You identify and escalate risks before they become emergencies.

- Highly organised: Your trackers, documents and follow-ups are accurate and updated.

- Resourceful: You find solutions instead of waiting for someone else.

- Systems-minded: You improve processes and automate repetitive work.

- Self-driven: You do not require constant reminders or supervision.

- Committed to improvement: You learn from mistakes and continuously raise your standards.



This Role Is Not for You If

- You only update trackers without analysing or acting on the information.

- You wait for your manager to identify every problem.

- You communicate delays only after deadlines have been missed.

- You need repeated follow-ups to complete agreed actions.

- You avoid accountability or difficult supplier conversations.

- You struggle with details, documentation or follow-through.



How to Apply

- Please submit your CV or profile along with a 3–6 minute video answering the following three questions:

1. Briefly introduce yourself, explain your relevant supply-chain experience and tell us why you are a strong fit for this role.

2. A key product will run out of stock in the US in four weeks. The UK has ten weeks of stock, supplier production is delayed by two weeks, sea freight takes five weeks and air freight costs four times more. A promotion is also planned in six weeks. Explain how you would manage the inventory, freight and promotion while working with limited cash.

3. A supplier informs you that 20% of a completed order has failed inspection three days before shipment. The remaining units are needed for an upcoming launch, and delaying the full shipment may cause a stockout. Explain how you would handle the supplier, inspection failure, shipment decision and internal communication—and what you would put in place to prevent the issue from happening again.



In your written application, please also include:

- Your current location.

- Your availability and notice period.

- Your expected monthly compensation.

- The approximate number of SKUs, suppliers and markets you have managed.

- The supply-chain and inventory tools you have used.

Begin your application with: “RIGHT STOCK, RIGHT TIME”

title: Head of Social Strategy
description:
Head of Social Strategy (we’re hiring a real Head of Social, not a social media manager)

Remote | Full-time



Own the social strategy for exciting new launches in toys & games



We're an established toys and games brand, coming off the back of one of the most successful sport-related backyard game products in the category. We're now transitioning into a wider sports-related toys and games company, speed running zero to one million customers over the next three years.



We're assembling a team of highly talented people to own each department, and this role is one of them.



Our thesis: anyone can copy a product. Nobody can copy a fan base.



The great modern game brands aren't selling objects in boxes. They're building platforms, and social content is how they do it:



-Spikeball took a backyard game and turned it into a genuine sport: active players, in-person events, and a real community.

-Popdarts took a simple table game and now kids call themselves Popdarts players, build Instagram handles around it, and show up to live events. It's become a niche sport in its own right.

-Exploding Kittens built a cult following of fans who wait for every new game and drop. A franchise, not a one-off product.

-Golf Daddy and Bucket Golf haven't built community at that level, but they've built huge social followings around their product and their game, proof of how far pure content can carry a brand.



That spectrum — from big social following all the way to genuine sport with real-world events — is exactly the playbook we're running across our portfolio.



For each of our hero products, this role strategies and owns the build: where on that spectrum the brand should live, and how content, community, and drops get it there.



The Role



You are the strategist and owner of organic growth across the entire portfolio.



This is not a traditional social media manager role. You're not simply scheduling posts or managing an existing content calendar.



You'll design the strategies and be accountable for getting them shipped and hitting numbers, working through creators, clippers, editors, and affiliate armies.



You'll own things like:



-Building our flagship new launch into a platform brand. Target: 250K Instagram followers, with an audience hooked on updates and drops.

-A short-form machine across TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. Target: 1 billion cumulative organic views portfolio-wide.

-The affiliate engine. This is central to how we'll grow. Traditional UGC and content sourcing is slow: one creator, one brief, one video at a time. Hudson Leogrande's brand Comfrt revolutionized it by building an army of affiliates on TikTok Shop, hundreds of core creators posting daily and thousands more on open enrollment, generating a torrent of content that then fuels Meta, Instagram, and AppLovin paid acquisition. That is the system we're building. Ideally you've worked with this model before; if not, you'll work with the team and founders on running it.

-Turning a product into a sport. Building a fan base and community from zero, with a roadmap to real-world events and competition.

-Creative that stands out. Coming up with ideas and running shoots that make our brands impossible to scroll past. We're always generating content that stands out, not doing the same as every other brand on Instagram.

-Monthly reporting to the founders. Growth, views, affiliate revenue, community, learnings, and next moves.



Why This Is a Rare Opportunity



-Whole-portfolio ownership from day one. You're not inheriting someone else's playbook or optimizing a mature account. You're writing the strategy for multiple new category launches, with the founders as your only stakeholders.

-Proven engine behind you. This isn't zero-to-one on a maybe. The existing brand does eight figures, paid acquisition is firing, and the products are already built. But great paid acquisition runs on a constant supply of high-level content, and generating that is exactly what this role owns. The organic flywheel is the missing piece, and the moat.

-Category timing. Physical games and backyard sports are having a generational moment, and short-form is how they blow up. The right operator here gets to put their name on category-defining launches.

-Lean, global, AI-first team where speed wins, shipping beats meetings, and you have direct access to both founders.



Who We're Looking For



-You've personally grown a brand or creator account to six-figures+ followers and can show us the account and the numbers.

-You've built or run an affiliate, clipper, or TikTok Shop creator program with revenue attached. Direct experience with the -Comfrt-style affiliate model is a major advantage; at minimum you need a genuine understanding of how it works and why it wins.

-You're incredibly creative and think outside the box: you generate original content ideas and can plan and run shoots, not just repost what every other brand is doing.

-You're platform-native: you know what's working on TikTok and Reels this month, not last year.

-You understand fandom: drops, scarcity, community, events. Games, sports, or toys experience is a big plus.

-You build systems, not one-offs: playbooks, trackers, repeatable machines.

-You move fast and use AI tools aggressively to multiply your output.



How to apply



Skip the cover letter. Send us:



1. Links to accounts or programs you've grown, with numbers

2. A one-page take: how would you take a brand-new game brand from 0 to its first 50K followers?



We're interested in your actual thinking and strategy — including your content approach, creator/affiliate strategy, community-building ideas, and how you would measure success.



Applications that do not include both requirements above may not be considered. Thank you

title: Help Desk Manager — US-Based MSP
description:
We are a Managed Service Provider (MSP) based in the Chicago suburbs (Illinois, USA). We provide IT support, Microsoft 365 management, cybersecurity, and backup/disaster recovery to small and mid-sized businesses across the Chicagoland area, including some clients in regulated industries.



We're a tight-knit, growing team and we're looking for a Help Desk Manager to help us deliver great service to our clients every day. You'll work closely with the owner and be a key part of our leadership as we grow.



This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll manage the ticket queue, but just as importantly, you'll actively mentor and develop our technicians, handle the more complex technical issues they escalate to you, and continuously raise the quality of our service. Our current technicians are capable and self-sufficient on day-to-day work — we're looking for someone who can take them to the next level while owning the harder problems and keeping our whole operation running smoothly.





WHAT YOU'LL DO:



Service Desk Operations:

- Manage the daily ticket queue in Autotask — prioritize, assign, and keep work moving

- Make sure tickets are resolved on time and clients are kept in the loop

- Spot recurring problems and work with the team to fix them for good

- Keep an eye on monitoring alerts and make sure nothing slips through



Team Development and Mentorship:

- Coach and mentor our technicians, actively helping them build new skills and grow into more complex work

- Identify skill gaps on the team and create clear paths to close them

- Review resolved tickets to find learning and improvement opportunities

- Run knowledge-sharing sessions and document best practices for the team

- Set technical standards and help the team consistently meet them

- Take our capable technicians and make them great



Client Relationships:

- Be a friendly, reliable point of contact for our clients

- Keep clients updated on their open issues

- Help resolve concerns before they become bigger problems

- Work alongside the owner on client reviews and building strong relationships



Technical Escalations and Higher-Tier Work:

- Serve as the escalation point for issues the L1/L2 team can't resolve

- Handle complex work involving Microsoft 365, Exchange, Intune, Conditional Access, Azure/Entra ID, and Active Directory

- Own root-cause analysis so recurring problems get fixed permanently, not just patched over

- Guide our field technician during onsite visits over Microsoft Teams

- Coordinate with vendors on tougher technical issues



Documentation, Process, and Quality:

- Keep IT Glue documentation accurate, complete, and useful

- Build and maintain SOPs so common issues get resolved consistently across the team

- Review ticket quality and documentation standards, and coach the team to improve

- Identify automation and efficiency opportunities to reduce repetitive work

- Contribute ideas to make our service better as we grow





The Partnership:

The owner is actively involved in the business every day — working with clients, driving growth, and supporting the team. You won't be left on an island. This role is about working together to build something great. As we grow, this role grows too, with real opportunity to shape how our service delivery works and to lead a larger team over time.





OUR TOOL STACK (experience with these is a big plus):

- Autotask PSA (ticketing and time tracking)

- Datto RMM

- NinjaOne (remote monitoring and management)

- IT Glue (documentation)

- Microsoft 365 Business Premium (Intune, Conditional Access, Exchange, Azure/Entra ID)

- Datto BCDR and SaaS Protection (backup)

- Huntress (managed EDR / security)

- Auvik (network monitoring)

- Fortinet firewalls & switches

- Cisco Merkaki hardware





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:



- At least 4 years working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment

- Some experience leading or coordinating a helpdesk/service desk team

- Hands-on experience with a PSA tool (Autotask, ConnectWise, Halo, or similar)

- Hands-on experience with an RMM tool (NinjaOne, Datto RMM, ConnectWise Automate, N-able, or similar)

- Experience with a documentation platform (IT Glue, Hudu, or similar)

- Solid Microsoft 365 administration skills

- Excellent written and spoken English — you'll talk with US clients by
, phone, and Teams

- Able to work US Central Time business hours 

- Reliable high-speed internet and a professional home office setup





NICE TO HAVE:



- Experience specifically with Autotask, NinjaOne, and IT Glue

- Microsoft certifications (MS-900, AZ-900, SC-900, or higher)

- Experience with Datto BCDR, Huntress, or FortiGate

- Experience supporting clients in regulated industries (healthcare, finance, etc.)

- PowerShell scripting

- ITIL familiarity





HOW TO APPLY:



To show us you've read this posting, please start your application with the word "MANAGED" and answer these three questions:



1. Which PSA and RMM tools have you used, and for how long?

2. Tell us about your experience in an MSP and any team you've supported or led.

3. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?



We read every application that follows these steps. We'll share more about our company, clients, and team during the interview process. We're excited to find the right person to grow with us.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Graphic Designer (AI Workflows & Automation)
description:

## Experienced Graphic Designer (AI Workflows & Automation) – We're Hiring! ##

We're an e-commerce and education group that ships product visuals daily, and we're looking for an experienced "superstar" graphic designer who works the modern way: not one prompt at a time, but building repeatable node-based AI pipelines that turn concepts into polished, production-ready graphics at scale. If you already think in nodes, blocks, and workflows, you'll feel right at home.



***EXPERIENCE NEEDED for this position***

Job Scope:

- Conceptualizing visuals based on requirements

- Developing product graphics from scratch

- Bringing visual improvements to existing products using your artistic talent

- Creating images and lifestyle visuals using design software and Photoshop

- Building and maintaining node-based AI pipelines in Weavy (Weave) and/or Magnific AI, connecting prompt, image, video, and upscaler blocks into repeatable, automated workflows

- Upscaling and enhancing imagery to crisp, production-grade quality

- Testing graphics across various media platforms

- Proven graphic design experience with a strong portfolio of illustrations or other graphics

- Hands-on experience building node-based AI workflows (Weavy, Magnific AI, ComfyUI, or similar node canvases)

- Familiarity with design software (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop)

- A keen eye for aesthetics and detail

- Excellent communication skills

- Ability to work methodically and meet deadlines

- Degree in Design, Fine Arts, or a related field is a plus



Note:

- Full-time basis - 40 hrs/week (Monday to Friday)

- Working hours: 10am to 6:30pm (30 min lunch break)

- 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holidays Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines) included



IMPORTANT: When applying, please provide:

- Your CV/Resume

- A short video introduction of yourself and why you think you're a good fit

- Why you are leaving your last job or what you were doing just before this application

- Reference links to your graphic design portfolio (Behance, Drive, Dropbox, etc.) AND examples of node-based AI workflows you have built (screenshots of your Weavy / Magnific / ComfyUI pipelines are welcome). If you have used comparable tools rather than these specific ones, please show them and say so



Applications that do not follow the above instructions will not be entertained. Applications with video introductions will be prioritized.



P.S. Please format your replies in point form according to the items asked above, e.g.:

My resume is here:

Video introduction here:

I am currently doing... / I am leaving because...

Here are examples of my work and workflows...



The more information you provide in your initial application, the better.



Best regards,

Loo Yi

title: Hubspot Senor Engineer
description:
CRM Magnetics is looking for a highly skilled HubSpot Solution Architect to lead complex client implementations and design scalable CRM systems for growing B2B companies.



We specialize in building advanced, high-impact HubSpot ecosystems — not basic setups. This role is for someone who wants to own solutions end-to-end, make decisions, and grow into a true architecture and leadership position.



About the Role

This is not just an execution role.



You will:

- Own full-cycle implementations — from discovery and architecture to delivery and optimization

- Design scalable CRM systems, not just configure tools

- Work directly with clients and influence business processes

- Take responsibility for technical decisions and final outcomes

We’re looking for someone who thinks like a system designer and problem-solver, not just a specialist.



Key Responsibilities:

- Lead end-to-end HubSpot implementations (discovery ? architecture ? delivery ? optimization)

- Translate business needs into scalable CRM and automation solutions

- Design CRM structures, workflows, data models, and reporting systems

- Own solution decisions and ensure best practices across projects

- Manage and guide implementation specialists (task delegation, QA, support)

- Identify gaps, risks, and opportunities in client systems proactively

- Work directly with clients in English (calls, documentation, consulting)

- Handle complex integrations (APIs, third-party tools, custom logic)



Requirements:

- Advanced HubSpot expertise (CRM, workflows, reporting, integrations)

- Proven experience with complex implementations (not just basic setups)

- Strong solution-thinking mindset — ability to design systems

- Experience leading projects or managing team members

- Strong problem-solving skills and ability to handle non-standard cases

- Fluent English (C1+) — client-facing role

- High ownership, responsibility and attention to detail



Nice to Have:

- RevOps / SalesOps / MarketingOps experience

- APIs, Zapier / Make, custom integrations

- SaaS / B2B background

- Experience designing scalable CRM architectures



Compensation & Growth

- Starting rate: $14/hour (Solutions Architect in Training)

- Training period is performance-based — no fixed timeline

- As soon as you demonstrate the ability to independently own projects ? immediate promotion and pay increase ($18+/hour)



We don’t slow people down — growth is based purely on capability and results.



Growth & Opportunity



We are a fast-growing agency with strong momentum.



Our systems are already structured, and we’re actively improving:

- Documentation

- Operational efficiency

- Automation and AI deployment



This role is not capped.



The right person will have the opportunity to:

1) Shape internal processes and technical standards

2) Influence how solutions are designed across the company

3) Grow into leadership roles such as:

- Implementation Team Lead

- Head of Solutions Architecture

- Future executive-level roles as the company scales



Who We’re Looking For



Someone who:

- Doesn’t wait for instructions — finds solutions independently

- Can take full ownership of projects and drive them to completion

- Understands business logic, not just tools

- Thinks like an architect, not just a technician

- Wants to join early, grow fast, and build something meaningful



If you're a strong HubSpot expert ready to step into a true architecture and leadership track, we’d love to hear from you.



How to Apply



To be considered for this role, please include:



1) 2–4 relevant HubSpot projects or case studies you’ve worked on

2) A brief description of:

- The client/business context

- What you were responsible for

- The solution you designed and implemented

3) Any links, screenshots, or Loom walkthroughs (if available)



Applications without relevant project examples will not be considered.



We will not consider candidates without experience at Hubspot or without case studies.

description:
Are you an experienced social media manager looking for a long-term position with ongoing educational training about social media? You might be just the right person we're looking for!



Just Simply Marketing (JSM) is a digital marketing agency based in Ontario, Canada, dedicated to helping business coaches, speakers, and experts from the US and Canada build, grow, and monetize their online brands. Specializing in organic marketing strategies, we focus on content creation, social media management, lead generation, and video production to help our clients stand out online. At JSM, we value creativity, excellence, and personal growth in everything we do.



You will work closely with our creatives, video editing and graphic design teams to review and approve videos and designs, ensuring it aligns with our clients' brand and strategy. As our Social Media Manager, you will be the driving force behind our clients' brand growth and increased online presence.



This is a fully remote position with a working hours from 6:00 PM to 2:00 AM PHT, Monday - Friday. The Social Media Specialist will have to report directly to the Social Media Team Managers.

Interested candidates, please apply through our application form:

3. Content Copywriting & Scriptwriting: You will curate meaningful and engaging content that resonates with our clients' target audiences and aligns with their brand identity. This includes writing scroll-stopping captions, scripts, and headlines tailored to different social media platforms.



4. Content Posting: You will handle the scheduling and posting of content across various social media platforms in line with the content calendar and the strategy you've created.

title: Short Form Video Editor
description:
About This Role

-We don’t need someone who can “edit videos.”

-We need someone who understands attention.



If you know how to hook in the first 2 seconds, control pacing, build tension with captions, and turn raw footage into content people actually finish watching — keep reading.



You’ll be responsible for creating high-impact vertical content designed to stop the scroll, increase retention, and drive measurable engagement across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



What You’ll Be Responsible For:

-Editing 15–60 second vertical videos optimized for performance

-Crafting powerful hooks that immediately grab attention

-Adding dynamic captions, motion graphics, sound effects, and transitions

-Repurposing long-form content into high-retention short clips

-Staying ahead of trends, viral formats, and platform behaviors

-Collaborating with marketing and content teams to align on brand voice

-Testing different hooks, pacing styles, and caption formats to improve metrics

-This role is not just about making things look good. It’s about making them perform.



What We’re Looking For

-1–3+ years editing short-form content specifically

-Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or equivalent

-Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, and retention strategy

-Deep familiarity with TikTok, Reels, and Shorts best practices

-Ability to meet tight deadlines without sacrificing quality

-A portfolio that clearly shows high-performing short-form content

-If your portfolio is generic, we’ll know. We’re looking for work that shows intentional editing and performance awareness.



Bonus If You Have

-Experience working with influencers or personal brands

-Motion graphics experience (After Effects is a plus)

-Knowledge of analytics, retention graphs, and optimization strategies

-Strong color grading and clean sound design skills



What Success Looks Like

-Higher engagement rates

-Increased watch time and completion rates

-Consistent, on-brand output

-Content that aligns with current platform behavior and trends

-Your edits should feel native to the platform — not like recycled content.



Why Join Us

-Real creative freedom

-A fast-moving, trend-driven environment

-Opportunity to grow with a scaling brand

-Competitive compensation based on experience and output

-If you’re obsessed with hooks, retention, pacing, and performance — you’ll thrive here.

Frame Solutions is a UK software company. We build ESTA a contract administration, cost management and reporting platform used by chartered surveying consultancies across the UK.

You will not be left to work it out. We provide structured training, written SOPs, and direct access to both Directors while you get up to speed.

A permanent, stable full-time position with a profitable company that has been growing steadily since founding

Direct access to the Directors.

Genuine progression. Our previous assistant in this role has moved into a marketing management position with us and will help onboard you.

s and documents

title: Creative Packaging Designer (Cosmetics / Gen-Z Beauty Trends)
description:
Important Application Instructions:

Do NOT just send a generic application. To ensure you have read this entire post and have the attention to detail we need, you must follow the specific instructions at the bottom of this page.



About Us:

We are Rude Cosmetics. We believe makeup is a tool of self-expression, and our brand is built on being bold, edgy, and completely unapologetic. We are looking for a highly creative Packaging Designer who has their finger on the pulse of current beauty trends to help design our next viral products.



The Role:

We are looking for a trendsetter. Your primary goal is to design eye-catching, creative packaging that appeals to a younger, trend-conscious demographic (Gen-Z and Millennials).



Note: While you will need to know how to place your artwork onto a flat dieline template, you do NOT need to handle the deep technical prepress work or communicate with our overseas manufacturers. We have an in-house production manager to handle the factory side! We just need your creative vision.



Key Responsibilities:



> Creative Packaging Design: Design the visual covers, typography, illustrations, and overall aesthetic for upcoming eyeshadow palettes, lipsticks, and skincare lines.



> Trend Translation: Keep up with current makeup, fashion, and social media aesthetic trends (e.g., Y2K revival, Soft Goth, Monochromatic) and translate them into packaging concepts that fit the "Rude" brand.



> Dieline Layout: Take your beautiful artwork and lay it out cleanly onto provided dieline templates so our production team can take it to the finish line.



> Moodboarding: Help our creative team visualize new collections by putting together aesthetic mood boards and concept decks.



Requirements:



> Trend-Focused Portfolio: You must have a portfolio that shows you understand how to design for younger audiences. We want to see bold colors, great typography, and modern aesthetics.



> Packaging Experience: You must have experience designing physical packaging (unit cartons, boxes, labels) and know how to work within a dieline template.



> Beauty Obsessed: A strong understanding of the cosmetics industry and what catches a consumer's eye on store shelves and on TikTok/Instagram.



> Software Mastery: Expert level in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.



> Bonus Skills: Basic 3D rendering skills to mock up your packaging concepts are a huge plus!



Working Hours & Pay:



> Hours: This is a long-term, part-time role (20 to 30 hours per week) with the potential to grow based on performance.



> Schedule: Flexible, but we require some overlap with PST (Pacific Standard Time) for quick communication and feedback.



Pay: $4.00 to $6.00 USD per hour, depending entirely on the strength of your creative portfolio and packaging experience.



How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY):

We are looking for someone with a sharp eye for detail and design. To prove you have read this entire job post, you must do the following:



Make the subject line of your message EXACTLY: BEAUTY TRENDS



Send us a message here on OnlineJobs with a direct link to your portfolio. Point us directly to the projects that show off your packaging design and your ability to design for modern, youthful trends.



Do not send a long, generic cover letter. Just the secret word and your portfolio link! If your aesthetic is a match for our brand, we will reply with the next steps.

title: Excel Operations Specialist
description:
About Self Bill Pro: 

Self Bill Pro is a rapidly growing startup dedicated to solving one of the most persistent challenges in the employee benefits ecosystem: the complexity of monthly benefits billing. We provide a tech-enabled service where our dedicated team leverages proprietary software to eliminate the administrative burdens of manual invoice audits and costly billing errors. Our mission is to streamline this critical operation, freeing up employers, brokers, and carriers to focus on their strategic priorities.



About the Role:

The Excel Operations Analyst supports core billing workflows within Self Bill Pro’s Manual Data Operations (MDO) team, working primarily in Excel to manage, clean, and structure complex data.

This role is hands-on and execution-focused, requiring you to work through high-volume, often imperfect datasets to ensure accurate invoicing and reconciliation. You’ll transform raw inputs, identify inconsistencies, and produce reliable outputs that power our billing processes.



While there are established workflows, success in this role requires independent problem-solving and sound judgment when working through unclear or incomplete data.

This is not a traditional business analyst role. The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, strong in Excel, and comfortable balancing structured processes with practical, day-to-day data problem solving in a fast-paced environment.

Requirements



Key Responsibilities:

Work directly in Excel to manage, clean, and transform data used in billing workflows

Execute data preparation for invoicing and reconciliation across multiple clients

Identify, investigate, and resolve data discrepancies, inconsistencies, and missing information

Perform detailed data validation and quality checks prior to output delivery

Support plan setup and billing preparation activities for new and existing clients

Work through incomplete or unclear datasets, applying judgment to move work forward accurately

Maintain and update Excel files, templates, and structured datasets

Partner with internal teams to ensure accurate and timely data delivery

Identify recurring data issues and contribute to process improvements



Qualifications:

Advanced Excel proficiency, including complex formulas, lookups, data manipulation, and efficient handling of large datasets

Experience working with large, complex, or high-volume datasets

Proven ability to clean, validate, and transform data from multiple sources

High attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and auditability

Ability to identify, investigate, and resolve data discrepancies and inconsistencies

Comfortable working with incomplete or unclear data, applying judgment to move work forward

Ability to follow structured processes while also adapting when needed

Strong organizational and time management skills in a fast-paced environment

Clear written and verbal communication skills

Required shift of US ET business hours (8pm–5am PHT), with potential transition to a second shift (3pm–12am PHT) following onboarding



Preferred Qualifications:

Experience working in employee benefits, insurance, or HR-related operations  

Familiarity with billing, invoicing, or reconciliation workflows  

Experience working with structured data formats (e.g., CSV, XML, LDE/LDEX)  

Exposure to process improvement or workflow optimization in a data-heavy environment  

Advanced Excel capabilities (e.g., Power Query, dynamic arrays, VBA/scripting)  



**Compensation is structured as monthly base pay before night differential, reflecting the scheduled working hours for this role. Scheduled hours are intended to align with U.S. Eastern Time. The 13th month pay is provided in addition to the stated base compensation in accordance with local requirements. **



Why Join Self Bill Pro:

At Self Bill Pro, you’ll join a collaborative and ambitious team dedicated to transforming outdated processes through smart, scalable technology. If you are a highly motivated individual with a passion for technology and a desire to make a difference in the employee benefits landscape, we encourage you to apply!

title: Short-Form Video Editor for Instagram Reels (Nutrition / Fitness Brand)
description:
About the role



I run a performance nutrition coaching business and I appear on podcasts regularly. I need someone to turn those long podcast recordings into short, punchy Instagram Reels.



The good news for you is that I hand you everything worked out in advance. The clip timestamps, the exact words being said, the on-screen hook text and notes on which b-roll to use and where. Your job is to cut it clean, make it vertical, caption it well and layer my own footage over the top so it looks professional and on-brand.



This is a one-off project to start, around 30 clips from recent episodes. If it goes well there is potential for more work down the line, as I record new podcasts fairly regularly, so I would love to find someone I can come back to.



What you will be doing



- Cutting short clips, roughly 30 to 60 seconds, from long podcast videos using the timestamps I give you

- Reframing to vertical 9:16 with speaker tracking so I stay in frame

- Adding clean, well-timed animated captions

- Adding the on-screen hook text for the first few seconds

- Layering my own b-roll over the talking head at the points I mark, from folders I share with you

- Light background music and tidy audio, then exporting ready to post



What I will give you



- The podcast video files

- A detailed brief for every clip: the timestamp, a transcript of the exact section, the hook text and notes on which b-roll to use

- Access to my B-roll folder and my race footage folders

- A style reference once we lock the look on the first few clips



What I need from you



- Solid short-form editing experience, ideally with fitness, sport or talking-head content

- Confident with captions and vertical reframing in CapCut, Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve

- A good eye for pace, and for where a clip should start and end

- Reliable communication and able to hit small agreed deadlines

- You only use the footage I provide. No stock footage and no generated graphics



Delivery

- Upload the finished clips to a shared Google Drive folder I will give you

- Export vertical 9:16, high quality, one file per clip, named to match the brief so I can find them easily, for example "Clip 03 nutrition is all grey"

- I handle all posting and the written post captions myself, so those are not your job. Your work is done once the edited clip is in the Drive folder

- To be clear, the animated captions on the video itself (the subtitles of what I am saying) are your job. It is only the written post caption and the posting I take care of



Hours and volume

- This is a one-off project of around 30 clips

- I would like the first 3 to 5 clips within the first week, so we can lock the style before you build the rest

- The full batch delivered within 2 to 3 weeks of starting, in weekly batches

- Potential for more work in future if it goes well, but no obligation on either side

- Flexible on when you work, as long as we agree deadlines and you hit them



How to apply

- Send me two or three examples of short-form vertical clips you have edited, ideally talking-head or fitness content

- Tell me which editing software you use

- Start your message with the word FUEL so I know you actually read this



Rate

- 6-8USD per finished clip, which is around 240 US dollars for the full batch of about 30. Paid in batches as clips are delivered and approved.

title: SEO Specialist for Danish Local Business Websites
description:
Long-Term SEO Specialist for Danish Business Clients



I run a Danish web agency that creates and improves websites for small and medium-sized businesses. I am now looking for a reliable SEO specialist for a potentially long-term working relationship.



The first client is Nordkyst Biler, a Danish used-car dealership located in Ishøj:







The objective is to improve the website’s technical SEO, local visibility and organic traffic from people interested in buying or selling a used car.



Hours and workload



There will be more work during the first month because the website requires an initial SEO setup.



Expected workload:



* First month: approximately 7-8 approved hours

* Following months: approximately 3–5 approved hours per month

* All hours must be agreed upon before work begins

* Additional work is always approved and paid separately



This is not a full-time position. It is a small monthly assignment that can grow as my agency gains more clients.



Monthly payment structure



The client pays my agency a monthly fee for SEO. I then use part of that payment to pay you for the approved SEO work.



You will be paid once per month for all approved and completed hours. Monthly work will only be scheduled after the client’s payment and SEO budget have been confirmed. You will always know the approved number of hours before beginning the work.



Please do not exceed the approved monthly hours without receiving permission first.



First-month responsibilities



The first month should establish a strong SEO foundation. The work should include:



* A technical, local and on-page SEO audit

* Danish keyword research

* Focus on relevant searches related to used cars, car dealerships and selling a car in Ishøj, Vestegnen and the Copenhagen area

* A keyword-to-page plan

* Optimization of the homepage and “Sell Your Car” page

* Improved page titles, meta descriptions, headings and internal links

* Review of indexing, XML sitemap, robots.txt and canonical URLs

* Ensuring login and irrelevant pages are not indexed

* Review of how sold or removed vehicles are handled

* Review of the dynamically generated vehicle pages

* Recommendations for scalable SEO templates for current and future vehicles

* Appropriate LocalBusiness and vehicle/product structured data

* Setup or review of Google Search Console and Google Analytics

* Review and optimization of the company’s Google Business Profile

* A short report showing completed work and recommended next steps



Ongoing monthly responsibilities



After the initial setup, the monthly workload will be smaller and focused on the highest-priority improvements.



The ongoing work may include:



* Reviewing Google Search Console

* Monitoring organic clicks, rankings and enquiries

* Checking that new vehicle listings are indexed correctly

* Checking that sold vehicles are handled correctly

* Completing one prioritized SEO improvement each month

* Fixing smaller technical SEO issues

* Improving Google Business Profile

* Providing a short monthly report and time log



Opportunities for additional paid work



The basic SEO agreement only includes a limited number of monthly hours.



Some clients may choose a more extensive SEO package. For Nordkyst Biler, this could include individually optimizing every vehicle listing with unique titles, descriptions, keywords, structured data and internal links.



If the client chooses this additional service, more hours will be approved and your payment will increase accordingly. This deeper work is not expected to be completed within the basic monthly hours.



I also expect my agency to gain additional clients. If you perform well, communicate clearly and deliver useful results for Nordkyst Biler, you will be my preferred SEO specialist for future client websites.



Each additional client will have a separate scope, number of hours and payment. Future work cannot be guaranteed, but I am looking for someone who can grow with the agency over time.



Requirements



* At least two years of practical SEO experience

* Strong technical, on-page and local SEO knowledge

* Experience with dynamic, inventory, e-commerce or automotive websites is preferred

* Experience with Google Search Console and GA4

* Experience with crawling and keyword research tools

* Ability to prioritize work within a limited monthly budget

* Good written English

* Clear communication and reliable time reporting

* Ability to explain exactly what was changed and why



You do not need to speak Danish fluently. However, you must be able to research Danish keywords and search intent carefully. All customer-facing Danish text will be reviewed before publication.



We only want ethical and sustainable SEO. Do not purchase backlinks, use private blog networks, create spam links or make major changes without approval.



How to apply



Start your application with the word “NORDKYST” so I know you have read the complete description.



Please answer the following:



1. What are three specific SEO issues or opportunities you notice on nordkystbiler.dk?

2. What would you prioritize during the first 7-8 hours?

3. How would you use only 3–5 hours effectively in the following months?

4. Do you have experience with local businesses, automotive websites or dynamic product listings?

5. Which SEO tools do you use?

6. What is your hourly rate?

7. Are you comfortable with varying hours and monthly payment?



Please include one relevant example or case study. Generic applications that do not mention the website will not be considered.

title: Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller
description:
Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller

Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-Time 

Experience Required: 1–2 Years



Turn Your Voice Into Your Biggest Asset



Are you the person who can get a "no" and still walk away with a callback? Do you thrive on the thrill of a great pitch and love closing the gap between a cold lead and a booked appointment? We're looking for a Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller who's ready to bring energy, persistence, and persuasion to a growing, fast-paced commercial real estate team.

This isn't just dialing numbers — it's the front line of our acquisitions pipeline for commercial properties, including office, retail, industrial, multifamily (5+ units), and mixed-use assets. Every call you make has the potential to turn into a deal, and every deal you help set up is a direct reflection of your skill on the phone. Commercial deals move differently than residential — longer relationships, bigger stakes, and owners or decision-makers who expect a caller who sounds like they know the space.

If you're confident, quick on your feet, and genuinely enjoy the game of turning "not interested" into "let's talk," we want to hear from you.



What You'll Do



Make outbound cold calls to commercial property owners, landlords, investors, asset managers, and brokers across asset classes (office, retail, industrial, multifamily, mixed-use)

Pull and build targeted call lists using county records, CRE data platforms, and public/private property databases

Identify and qualify off-market and undervalued commercial properties based on owner motivation, property condition, and financial indicators

Gather key property details: lease type (NNN, gross, modified gross), tenant occupancy/vacancy status, square footage, zoning, and ownership structure

Research and reach decision-makers directly — including owners, property managers, LLC representatives, and asset managers — not just front-desk contacts

Set qualified appointments for our acquisitions/sales team with clear notes on deal potential

Maintain and update CRM with detailed call notes, property data, and lead status

Follow call scripts while keeping conversations natural, credible, and tailored to commercial owners

Hit daily/weekly call volume, talk-time, and lead generation targets

Handle objections with confidence — especially from sophisticated owners, brokers, and gatekeepers who are used to fielding investor calls



What You Bring



1–2 years of experience in a call center handling international accounts, and/or real estate cold calling — commercial experience strongly preferred

Excellent English communication skills (neutral accent preferred)

Comfort speaking with business owners, investors, and brokers — not just residential homeowners

Strong persuasion and negotiation instincts — you know how to read a conversation and steer it

Ability to work independently and stay motivated with minimal supervision

Comfort with high-volume outbound calling and skip tracing/contact research

Experience pulling and building your own lead lists (county records, CRE data platforms, or similar tools)

A target-driven mindset and genuine competitive streak

Familiarity with CRM systems (a plus, not a must)



Bonus Points For



Working knowledge of commercial real estate terminology: cap rate, NOI, NNN/gross leases, cash-on-cash return, CRE asset classes

Experience cold calling for office, retail, industrial, or multifamily acquisitions specifically

Experience with lead generation tools, skip tracing platforms, and auto-dialers

Familiarity with list-pulling/data platforms such as PropStream, Reonomy, CoStar, or county assessor records

Prior appointment-setting experience for acquisitions or investment sales teams

Sharp listening skills and objection-handling instincts with sophisticated, high-value prospects



Why You'll Want This Role



Competitive base salary — get rewarded for showing up and doing the work

Performance-based incentives/bonuses — the better you perform, the more you earn

Real growth opportunities — this is a growing company, and top performers won't go unnoticed

A supportive, performance-driven team — we win together, and we celebrate wins



Ready to Make Your Calls Count?



Send your updated resume and a short recording (Loom or Vocaroo — link only)

title: Energy modeling specialist
description:
You are a building energy modeling specialist. You have 3 to 7 years of hands-on experience running full building energy simulations and you know the difference between a well-built model and a model that simply runs. You take modeling seriously and your work product reflects it. 



You are an IES VE expert. IES Virtual Environment is your primary simulation tool. You know it deeply: you can build geometry from scratch, assign constructions, configure HVAC systems, set up occupancy and lighting profiles, run compliance checks, and interpret results. You do not need to be trained on IES VE. 



You know ASHRAE 90.1-2022 inside and out. You have applied both the Energy Cost Budget (ECB) method and the Performance Rating Method (PRM) on real projects. You understand the mandatory requirements, prescriptive path, and how the compliance pathways differ and when each applies. 



You are proficient in the 2024 IECC. You understand the 2024 International Energy Conservation Code commercial provisions including the mandatory requirements, prescriptive compliance path, and Energy Rating Index (ERI) compliance options. You can navigate Section C401 through C408 without looking everything up. 



You understand building systems at a technical level. Envelope assemblies, U-values, SHGC, infiltration rates, HVAC system types and efficiencies, lighting power densities, and plug loads are part of your everyday vocabulary. You know how modeling assumptions affect results. 



You are a strong communicator. You write and speak English at a professional level. You can explain complex energy model results to engineers, architects, and clients in a way that is accurate and understandable. This is a requirement, not a preference. 



You are detail-oriented and self-directed. You catch your own errors before they become client-facing problems. You manage your time, meet deadlines, and produce deliverables that do not require extensive rework. 



 



WHAT YOU WILL DO 



Perform complete building energy simulations using IES VE for new construction, major renovation, and retrofit projects across multiple building types including Healthcare, Mission Critical, Higher Education, and Government facilities. 



Conduct ASHRAE 90.1-2022 compliance modeling using both the Energy Cost Budget (ECB) method and the Performance Rating Method (PRM). Document the baseline building configuration, proposed design, and performance results in accordance with the standard. 



Perform 2024 IECC commercial energy compliance analysis including mandatory requirements review, prescriptive path compliance verification, and trade-off calculations. Produce compliance documentation suitable for submittal to authorities having jurisdiction (AHJ). 



Model all major building systems within IES VE including building envelope assemblies (walls, roofs, floors, fenestration), HVAC systems (air-side and water-side), domestic hot water, lighting systems, plug loads, and on-site renewable energy where applicable. 



Evaluate energy conservation measures (ECMs) through parametric modeling. Run multiple design scenarios, compare results, and provide clear recommendations with supporting data to help clients and design teams make informed decisions. 



Collaborate with commissioning engineers to compare modeled system performance against installed equipment schedules and sequences of operation. Identify discrepancies and support the commissioning process with energy-based analysis. 



Coordinate with project architects and MEP engineers of record to obtain accurate model inputs including construction assemblies, equipment schedules, ventilation rates, and occupancy data. Document all assumptions clearly and maintain an assumption log for each project. 



Prepare clear, professional energy model reports documenting methodology, inputs, results, and conclusions. Reports must be suitable for client delivery and regulatory submittal. 



Support Building Envelope Commissioning (BECx) efforts with thermal bridging analysis, condensation risk review, and energy impact assessment of envelope performance gaps. 



Stay current with code updates, standard revisions, and software developments. As ASHRAE standards and energy codes evolve, you will be expected to adapt modeling practices accordingly. 



 



POSITION REQUIREMENTS 



Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering, Architectural Engineering, Building Science, or a closely related field (required) 



3 to 7 years of hands-on building energy modeling experience on real construction projects (required) 



Proficiency in IES Virtual Environment (IES VE) is required and nonnegotiable. Candidates who do not have demonstrated IES VE experience will not be considered. 



INTERVIEW REQUIREMENT: All candidates must present a minimum of two completed IES VE energy models during the interview. Candidates will be expected to walk through their modeling approach, explain key assumptions, identify compliance outcomes, and answer detailed technical questions about the models. Presenting borrowed or template models is grounds for immediate disqualification. 



POSITION REQUIREMENTS 

-Demonstrated proficiency in ASHRAE 90.1-2022 including ECB method, PRM compliance pathway, mandatory provisions, and envelope and mechanical system requirements 

-Demonstrated proficiency in 2024 IECC commercial energy provisions including mandatory requirements, prescriptive compliance, and trade-off compliance paths 

-Familiarity with EnergyPlus or DOE-2 simulation engines is a plus 

-Exceptional English proficiency, written and verbal, at a professional business level (required, nonnegotiable) 

-Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Excel, and Outlook 

-Must be available to work hours that overlap with US Central Time (CST) business hours on a consistent, daily basis 

-Full time position, minimum 40 hours per week

title: Real Estate Video Editor — The Media Company
description:
About Us



The Media Company is a real estate media company based in Kingston, Ontario, Canada. We shoot photography, iGuide floor plans, 3D tours, and video for realtors — but video is our flagship. We're known as the best in our market for high-end real estate video, and video is the core of everything we build.



We're growing into a monthly content subscription for realtors — short-form videos that build their personal brand on social media — and we need a skilled editor to help us deliver it at a consistently high standard.



The Role



You'll edit two kinds of content:



Personal brand / social content for realtors: talking-head videos, location showcases, behind-the-scenes clips, and market updates — short-form (60–90 seconds), built for Reels and TikTok.

Listing videos — cinematic property showcases that are the premium product our business is built around.



This isn't a "throw footage together" job. We have a defined style — pacing, colour, music, captions, audio — and you'll be trained on it before touching real client work.



What You'll Do

Edit raw footage into polished, delivery-ready videos following our style bible (pacing, colour grading with provided LUTs, music selection, captioning, purposeful transitions)

Clean, level, and mix audio to a "crispy audio" standard — no hums, hiss, clicks, or wind noise, ever

Cut ruthlessly for hook and pacing — the first 2–3 seconds of every video need to earn attention

Follow our Final Cut Pro workflow standards (project naming, library structure, asset organization)

Submit work through our review process, take feedback from the lead editor, and revise until it hits the bar

Communicate clearly and hit deadlines without needing to be chased

What We're Looking For

Final Cut Pro expertise — this is the one hard requirement. If you primarily edit in Premiere or DaVinci, this isn't the role for you.

Experience editing short-form, social-first content (Reels, TikTok, Shorts)

A strong eye for pacing, colour, and music — someone who can make raw footage feel intentional, not just cut it down

Real estate or personal-brand content experience is a strong plus, but not required if your reel shows the right instincts

Comfortable receiving detailed, specific feedback and iterating quickly

Reliable communicator — someone who flags problems early instead of going quiet

Training & Onboarding



New editors go through a structured 3–4 week onboarding: our style bible, our Final Cut Pro workflow standards, our content formats, a practice edit that has to pass a real quality review, and then supervised work on live client videos before moving to independent work. You'll be trained directly by our lead editor, with final sign-off from our founder.

title: Business Analyst – Property Management Operations

Business Analyst – Property Management Operations

Job Details

Location: Remote (Eastern Time)

Compensation: Based on experience

How to Apply

Please submit your resume to 



About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Business Analyst to help streamline and strengthen the operations of our growing residential, commercial, and HOA property management portfolio. This role will work closely with leadership, property management teams, accounting, and maintenance to identify process gaps, design improved workflows, and implement data-driven solutions that increase efficiency, consistency, and service quality across the business.

The ideal candidate is a strong problem-solver with experience mapping and improving business processes, analyzing operational data, and translating findings into practical recommendations — ideally within property management or a similarly fast-paced, service-driven industry.

Key Responsibilities

Process Analysis & Improvement

Evaluate current property management workflows (maintenance coordination, lease administration, move-ins/move-outs, rent collection, vendor management, owner reporting) to identify inefficiencies and bottlenecks.

Document current-state processes ("as-is") and design improved future-state ("to-be") workflows and SOPs.

Partner with team leads and department heads to implement process changes and measure their impact.

Identify opportunities for automation and technology adoption to reduce manual work and errors.

Data & Reporting

Collect, analyze, and interpret operational data (response times, work order completion, occupancy, delinquency, renewals, CSAT) to identify trends and root causes.

Build and maintain dashboards and reports that give leadership visibility into KPIs and portfolio performance.

Translate raw data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for leadership.

Systems & Tools

Assess how effectively existing platforms (e.g., Buildium, AppFolio, Propertyware, Rent Manager, Yardi) are being used and recommend configuration or workflow improvements.

Support system implementations, integrations, and upgrades by gathering requirements and testing changes.

Serve as a liaison between property management staff and technical/software resources.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with Property Management, Accounting, Maintenance, and Executive Leadership to understand pain points and align on solutions.

Support new client onboarding and property transitions by documenting requirements and identifying process risks.

Facilitate meetings and workshops to gather requirements, present findings, and drive alignment on process changes.

Quality & Compliance

Monitor adherence to SOPs and company standards, flagging inconsistencies across teams or portfolios.

Support the development and tracking of KPIs and performance metrics used to evaluate team and process effectiveness.

title: Video editor DTC brand — Well Payed Part-time
description:

We are an e-commerce brand in the beauty niche. Currently in full expansion, we're strengthening our creative team to keep producing ads that actually convert.

That's why we're looking for a motivated AI Video Editor, ready to get involved in our brand's growth.



-----------------------

YOUR MISSION :

-----------------------

Produce high-volume, AI-generated ad creative that's genuinely comfortable blending into ads that convert — not obviously AI. You should be able to cut confidently across styles: AI UGC, voiceover + b-roll, greenscreen/AI avatar, claymation/Pixar/3D animation, podcast-style, and whatever's winning right now.

What you'll actually need to be good at:

-----------------------

* Hooks & retention editing — you know the first 3 seconds make or break an ad, and how to hold attention with pattern interrupts, zooms, jump cuts and pacing.

* Pacing & rhythm — you cut to the energy of the voiceover/script, tight where it needs to be.

* Storytelling to a script — you build the visual story around a VO/script so the message lands.

* B-roll sourcing & sequencing (incl. AI-generated) — finding or generating the right supporting footage and placing it with purpose.

title: Inbound Sales Closer (Full-Time, Permanent) — $1,400 Base + Uncapped Commission | No Cold Calling | Hormozi-Trained US
description:
Same info as below, just nicer: 



START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THE WORD "CLOSER" IN ALL CAPS.

Applications without it are rejected without being read.





THE SHORT VERSION



•  $1,400/month base + 1% of every sale you close. UNCAPPED.

   Realistic earnings once ramped: $2,200–$2,800/month. Top performance: $3,400+.

   There is no ceiling — the commission has no cap and never will.



•  100% warm inbound. Zero cold calling. Zero lead generation.

   Buyers call US with their card in hand and questions a website can't answer.

   Your job: answer them and close.



•  Full-time remote. Monday–Friday, 10:30 AM – 8:30 PM US Central Time.

   Hiring from Latin America and the Philippines.



•  Trained on Alex Hormozi's sales system. In August 2026, Alex Hormozi and the

   
 team personally advised us at their workshop. Adding YOU is the

   #1 growth move they told us to make — and you'll be onboarded with the

   
 Closer Handbook they gave us.





WHO WE ARE



Merge Screens (
) sells plug-and-play CarPlay / Android Auto

touchscreen upgrades for US pickup trucks — Ford F-150/F-250/F-350, Chevy

Silverado, GMC Sierra, RAM, Toyota Tundra. Customers love the product;

installation is DIY or done by our partner installers.



Our growth: $60k (2021) ? $300k (2022) ? $1M (2023) ? $1.5M (2024) ? $4.5M (2025).

This year we're pushing for 8 figures.



Until today we've sold almost 100% through the website. You will be our FIRST

dedicated closer — the person who turns our phone line into a sales channel.

This is not a support role with sales on the side. It's the sales seat, and

it's empty.





THE MATH — READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING



•  Average order: $1,200–$2,200. With multi-vehicle orders and add-ons: $3,000+.



•  Your daily queue: ~13 inbound pre-purchase calls (hot buyers with questions)

   + ~10 abandoned checkouts with phone numbers (average cart value $1,526).

   Nobody is working these today.



•  You earn 1% of every dollar you close. A typical sale pays $12–$22.

   A multi-screen order with add-ons pays $30–$40+.

   Close 3 sales/day ? about $950/month commission ($2,350 total).

   Close 5/day with strong add-on attach ? $1,800–$2,100 ($3,200–$3,500 total).



•  Proof this is real: our customer-support agent — no sales training, handling

   sales as one-third of his job — earned $450/month in commissions under a

   weaker comp plan. You'll do this full-time, trained, with the whole queue

   to yourself.





WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



•  Answer inbound pre-purchase calls and close them live. Calls run 15–20

   minutes: you diagnose (what truck, what problem, how many vehicles), build

   the cart as a Shopify draft order, and either send the checkout link by SMS

   so the customer pays while you're on the phone — or take their card over

   the phone and place the order for them (very common with US buyers).



•  Call abandoned checkouts the same day and recover them.



•  Open every call the way Hormozi taught us: "How many vehicles did you want

   screens for?" Most US households own 2+ vehicles — multi-unit selling is

   the norm here, not a stretch.



•  Attach add-ons customers genuinely want: wireless upgrade bundles, extended

   warranty, cameras. This is where good closers separate from average ones.



•  Build your own follow-up system for the "let me check with my wife" calls.

   We give you the tools (JustCall, SMS, company
); the discipline and

   the system are yours to build and own.



•  Feed what you hear back to us. Your calls are free R&D for our FAQ, product

   pages and ads — you'll have a direct line to the founders.





WHERE THIS GOES



We're following a plan to take this company to $10M+ with phone sales and

advertising scaling as core channels. When call volume doubles, we hire

closer #2 — and the first closer who performs becomes the obvious pick to

lead the team. You'd be employee-one of a sales org, not a seat in one.





YOU ARE



•  Experienced: 2+ years closing B2C sales on the phone — high-volume,

   transactional (15–30 min cycles, not enterprise deals).



•  A near-native English speaker with a neutral accent. Our buyers are

   American truck owners.



•  Fluent in your own numbers: you know your close rate, average ticket and

   calls/day from your last role, and you can back them up.



•  Autonomous: you don't wait to be managed. You see the queue, you work the

   queue, you build the system that squeezes more out of it.



•  A student of the craft: ready to master our scripts and the 150-page

   
 Closer Handbook in your first two weeks.



•  Set up to work: quiet space, headset, reliable fiber internet, backup

   power/internet if your area needs it.





COMPENSATION & TERMS



•  $1,400/month base + 1% uncapped commission on sales you close live on the

   phone (customer pays during your call via draft-order checkout link or card).



•  15 paid vacation days per year.



•  Schedule: Monday–Friday, 10:30 AM – 8:30 PM US Central (10-hour shift,

   includes 1 hour of paid breaks: a 30-min meal plus short breaks, scheduled

   around the slow windows). The queue is live all day — the longer you're on

   the phones, the more you close.



•  Paid monthly in USD. Independent contractor. Long-term role — we're

   building a team, not filling a gig.



•  Hiring process: screening questions ? 20-min culture interview ? a final

   interview where you prove your sales skills live. We move fast — days,

   not weeks.





HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your application with the word CLOSER (all caps), followed by a

   max-150-word introduction.



2. Record a 60–90 second voice note (Vocaroo, Loom or similar — paste the

   link) answering this live, as if the customer were on the phone:



   "I love the screen, but I'm not sure it fits my 2019 F-150 — and honestly,

   $1,300 feels steep."



3. Answer the screening questions.





SCREENING QUESTIONS

 

1. YOUR NUMBERS. In your last phone sales role: what did you sell, what was

   the average ticket, your close rate, and your calls per day? How could we

   verify these numbers if we asked?

 

2. FOLLOW-UP. A hot caller says "I need to check with my wife" and hangs up.

   Describe your EXACT follow-up over the next 7 days: how many touches,

   which channels, what timing, and roughly what each message says.

 

3. UPSELL. A customer is buying one $1,299 screen for his F-150. Walk us

   through, in your words, how you'd turn this into a bigger order without

   being pushy.

 

4. LOGISTICS. Confirm you can work Monday–Friday, 10:30 AM – 8:30 PM US

   Central Time. What city are you in, what is that window in your local

   time, and what's your earliest start date?

 

5. MONEY. Based on the numbers in this post (daily queue, order values, the

   1% commission), what do you realistically expect to be earning here by

   month 3 — base plus commission? Show your math.
