title: Hiring: Advanced Video Editor — Long-Form YouTube Essays, Reels, Podcast
description:
About the role



We run a YouTube channel, two instagram pages, and a membership community. We're looking for an editor with real video editing and animation skills, plus the ability to own content editing from raw footage -> long form polished edit -> short form edits and repurposing content as needed. 



This is an ongoing, recurring role (per-video or weekly, negotiable) covering the full pipeline: long-form YouTube essays (30–40 min), podcast uploads (just the audio file from the long form content videos), thumbnails, and short-form Reels cut from the long-form material.



Technical requirements



- Dynamic masking & layering: Rotoscope/masking the subject(s) to composite them in front things onscreen

- Comfortable with keyframed mask tracking across moving subjects, not just static crops.

- Pattern interruptions / cutting rhythm: Break up static talking-head footage every few seconds using punch-in zooms, meme splices, and GIF cutaways — timed to beats in the VO, not randomly dropped in.

- Understand pacing well enough to combat attention drop-off across a 30–40 minute runtime without making the edit feel frantic of overdone

- Textual overlays / kinetic typography: Syncing quote cards, text, research citations, etc. over the footage according the the VO

- J-cuts & L-cuts

- color grading

- 2d onscreen stop motion animation 

- Multimedia intercutting: intercut archival footage, stock clips, screen recordings, still images, and audio clips within a single sequence — multi-track compositing, not just A/B-roll switching.

- Basic video editing skills, of course





Plus Additional pipeline responsibilities:



- Long-form YouTube editing (using the skills above)

- Short form content editing (reels; using the skills above)

- Repurposing long form content into short form reels

- Content sourcing: Source appropriate footage, imagery, film clips, and reference material (YouTube, Pinterest, archive sites, etc.) that the masking and intercutting techniques above depend on.

- Creating YouTube thumbnails

- Creating Reel covers

- Exporting mp3 files of long form content



Tools/Skills

- A real NLE with compositing capability — Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or After Effects (masking/roto and multi-track work isn't feasible in a transcript-based editor alone; Descript may be used for the initial assembly/transcript-based cut, but final compositing needs a proper timeline tool).

- A thumbnail/graphics tool (Photoshop, Canva, etc.)

- Comfortable sourcing and downloading reference footage/images from YouTube, Pinterest, and archival sources.

- Familiarity with uploading/publishing to YouTube and a podcast host.

- Excellent English proficiency



What I'm looking for in you

- Real command of masking/keying, keyframed text, split edits, and multi-track compositing — not template-based or AI-slop-auto-edit work.

- Can own the full pipeline: raw footage ? composited long-form edit ? thumbnail ? published YouTube video ? podcast upload ? repurposed Reels.

- Strong pacing instincts for long-form (30–40 min) content — know how to keep attention without making the edit feel chaotic.

- Comfortable doing your own research/sourcing for the footage and imagery your composites depend on.

- Precise with instructions like "cut whole sentences only"

- Unique and creative artistic taste and eye. We are not looking for content that looks like everyone else's. 



To apply:

Send a reel or examples showing masking/compositing work (subject placed into archival footage or scenes), J-cut/L-cut usage in a long-form piece, and text/citation overlay work.



please note: generic "talking head" video edit submissions will not be considered.

title: Call Center Manager – Remote**PLEASE READ JOB POST**
description:
Company: Small Town Roofing & Construction

Position: Call Center Manager

Location: Remote

Serious Inquiries Only



About the Position



Small Town Roofing & Construction is looking for an experienced Call Center Manager to take ownership of our outbound call center team.



We are looking for someone who can do more than simply manage employees. We need a strong leader who can help us grow our team, improve our processes, increase appointment production, develop better call scripts, train our representatives, and hold the team accountable for results.



Previous call center management experience is REQUIRED.



Responsibilities



As our Call Center Manager, you will be responsible for:



Managing and leading our outbound call center representatives.

Helping recruit, interview, onboard, and train new call center representatives.

Growing and developing the call center team.

Creating and improving cold-call scripts, appointment-setting scripts, rebuttals, and objection-handling scripts.

Reviewing scripts regularly and making changes based on performance.

Listening to recorded calls and providing coaching and feedback.

Conducting regular training and role-playing sessions.

Monitoring employee attendance, productivity, and performance.

Setting daily and weekly goals for representatives.

Holding representatives accountable for meeting performance expectations.

Identifying underperforming representatives and creating improvement plans.

Helping develop incentive programs and strategies to improve production.

Working directly with ownership to continuously improve the call center.

KPI Tracking & Weekly Reporting



You must have experience tracking and managing call center KPIs.



You will be responsible for monitoring metrics such as:



Total calls/dials

Calls answered

Contact rate

Conversations

Appointments booked

Appointments confirmed

Appointment show/inspection rate

Conversion rate

Contracts/sales generated from appointments

Individual representative performance

Team performance



You will be expected to prepare a weekly KPI and performance report for ownership explaining:



How the team performed

Which representatives are performing well

Which representatives need improvement

Where leads are being lost in the call funnel

Problems you've identified

Changes you've made

Your recommendations for improving results the following week



We do not want someone who simply sends numbers. We want a manager who understands what the numbers mean and knows how to use them to improve the team.



Call Script Experience – REQUIRED



You must be comfortable creating call scripts from scratch.



You should have experience developing or improving:



Cold-call scripts

Appointment-setting scripts

Opening statements

Closing statements

Objection rebuttals

Follow-up scripts

Voi
 scripts

Training scripts



You should also understand how to test different scripts, review call recordings, monitor conversion rates, and adjust scripts based on actual results.



Qualifications



You MUST have:



Previous experience managing a call center.

Experience managing outbound callers or appointment setters.

Strong English communication skills.

Experience creating and improving call scripts.

Experience tracking KPIs and preparing performance reports.

Experience coaching and training representatives.

Experience listening to and evaluating recorded calls.

Strong leadership and organizational skills.

Ability to identify problems and create solutions.

Ability to hold employees accountable while maintaining a positive team environment.

Experience working with CRM and/or dialer systems.

Reliable computer and high-speed internet.

Ability to work during U.S. business hours.



Experience with roofing, home improvement, solar, insurance, real estate, storm restoration, or other outbound home-service campaigns is a major plus.



Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who thinks like a leader and builder.



We want someone who will come to us and say:



"I found this problem, here's why I think it's happening, and here's what I recommend we do to fix it."



We are looking for someone who can help us build a stronger, more productive, and more professional call center as the company grows.



This is not a position for someone looking to simply clock in, supervise employees, and clock out.



Serious and experienced applicants only.



REQUIRED Video Application



A video recording is REQUIRED to be considered for this position.



Please submit a 2–3 minute video of yourself speaking in English and tell us:



Your name and where you are located.

How many years of call center management experience you have.

How many representatives you have managed at one time.

What type of call centers or campaigns you have managed.

Whether you have managed outbound cold callers or appointment setters.

Whether you have personally created call scripts and rebuttals.

Which KPIs you have been responsible for tracking.

How you have improved the performance of a call center you've managed.

Why you believe you would be a good fit for this position.

title: Backend Developer (Python)
description:
Ultra Labs is seeking a highly skilled Backend Python Developer to design, build, and maintain the server infrastructure powering our growing portfolio of media and technology businesses across Asia. The ideal candidate has strong experience with Python-based frameworks, is comfortable architecting proxy layers and third-party integrations, and can build systems that stay resilient and performant under real-world load. This role is central to how our applications talk to external services, so reliability, error handling, and thoughtful architecture matter as much as clean code.

_Create and manage proxy request layers to connect with external data engines.

_Build resilient integrations with third-party APIs, handling rate limits, retries, and error states.

 support inbox and take this work off our plate.



??  inbox (order status, cancellations, refunds, product questions) following our detailed written SOP

- Actively manage chargeback prevention and recovery using Chargeblast and Disputifier — respond to alerts, submit evidence, and keep our chargeback rate low

- Keep our response times fast and our tone consistently warm and professional

- Log and organize cases so nothing falls through the cracks

- Work confidently inside Shopify, our subscription app, and our help desk

- Trustworthy, honest, and takes full ownership of the inbox

- Reliable internet and a quiet work environment

- Flexible availability to cover a broad time window — our customers are international (US, UK, AU, EU)



WHAT WE OFFER:

- Long-term, stable role with a growing brand

- Competitive hourly pay of $4–$6 USD/hour based on your experience, plus performance bonuses

- A clear SOP plus AI-assisted tools that make your job faster and easier

ed you!" — write exactly how you would respond to her.

title: Full-Time Dashboard Developer - Build Our Multi-Store P&L Command Center
description:
Type: Full-time · Remote Salary: $1,000 USD fixed price + month + performance bonuses for extra scope Start: ASAP the core dashboard must be live before Q4 (October at the absolute latest)



The problem we want you to solve



We run a multi-brand e-commerce group with 5 Shopify stores across the UK, US & EU , spending daily on Meta, Google and Pinterest Ads.



Right now our numbers live in different places: Shopify admin, three ad platforms, supplier COGS sheets, refund reports, spreadsheets. Every decision starts with tab-switching and manual checking.



We want one screen. A command center where we open a browser tab and instantly see, per store and blended: revenue, ad spend, COGS, refunds, ROAS, blended ROAS, profit and profit margin for today, the last 7 days, the last 30 days, or any custom date range.



If you have built something like this before, this job is straightforward for you. If you haven't, please don't apply.



What you will build (Phase 1)



Data connections



All 5 Shopify stores connected via API, with a clean architecture so we can add store #6, #7, #8 later without a rebuild

Meta Ads, Google Ads and Pinterest Ads connected for live ad spend per store

COGS pulled in per store either from Shopify or from our supplier system / cost sheets



Metrics

Revenue, ad spend, COGS, refunds, contribution margin

ROAS per platform and blended ROAS

Net profit and profit % per store and across the group

Order count, AOV, refund rate



Views



A multi-store view: everything visible in one consolidated set of charts

A per-store view: drill into any single brand

Clear, readable graphs for yesterday / 7 days / 30 days, plus a custom date picker

Period-over-period comparison so we can see whether we are growing or bleeding



Automation



Daily Slack update with yesterday's key numbers per store

Weekly Slack update with growth vs. the previous week

Must-have requirements

A demonstrable track record building a P&L / profit dashboard. Screenshots, a live demo, a Loom walkthrough or a repo — we want proof, not promises.

Comfortable working with APIs and API keys (Shopify Admin API, Meta Marketing API, Google Ads API, Pinterest API)

Hands-on with Supabase and/or Vercel for building and deploying

You work with Claude Code, Claude or Codex as part of your daily workflow — we build fast here

Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills — a lot of our cost and supplier data still starts life in a spreadsheet

Good written English and reliable daily communication



Bonus points (this is how you earn more)

Bookkeeping / accounting skills. We also need our finance side organized — invoices, costs and P&L all in one clean place. If you can build that system (or run it yourself), tell us. This alone can raise your offer.

You can optimize multiple workflows: sheet automation, accounting flows, backend dashboards. The more of our stack you can own, the more projects we hand you.

Experience with e-commerce / dropshipping data specifically

Growth path



Phase 1 is the P&L command center. After that we want to build:



A supply chain dashboard on top of the same system

A product listing system



This can run as a long-term full-time role or as project-based work — whichever fits you better. We are open to your proposal.



How to apply



Read this carefully, because we filter hard on it.



Start your message with the word READY. Applications that don't will be deleted unread.



Then send us:



Your track record — links, screenshots, a demo or a Loom of a P&L or analytics dashboard you actually built. Show us the real thing.

What you would build for us — the stack you'd use and a rough timeline to get Phase 1 live.

How you'd handle COGS — in 3 sentences: how would you get accurate cost-of-goods into the dashboard when it doesn't live cleanly inside Shopify? (This tells us more than a CV does.)

Your position on the offer — confirm you're open to $1,000 USD/month, or make us a proposal. If you want to build the extra pieces (accounting system, supply chain, listing tool) tell us what that's worth and we'll talk. We pay for people who make us money.



We reply fast to strong applications. Looking forward to seeing what you've built.

title: US Tax Professional — IRS Enrolled Agent
description:
# U.S. Enrolled Agent — Offshore Tax Resolution Specialist



---



POSITION OVERVIEW



We are seeking a highly capable U.S. Enrolled Agent (EA) based in the Philippines to support U.S. federal tax resolution, tax compliance, and IRS representation matters.



This role is intended for a professional who can do more than prepare returns. The ideal candidate understands IRS procedure, can analyze taxpayer records and transcripts, communicate effectively with the IRS, and independently move tax-resolution cases toward resolution.



This is a full-time remote position supporting a U.S.-based tax resolution operation.



---



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



```

      - Represent taxpayers before the IRS within the scope permitted to Enrolled Agents



      - Prepare and manage IRS Power of Attorney filings, including Form 2848



      - Contact the IRS Practitioner Priority Service and other IRS departments on behalf of clients



      - Obtain, review, and analyze:



                - Account transcripts



                - Wage and Income transcripts



                - Tax Return transcripts



                - Record of Account transcripts



                - Collection history and account activity



      - Identify outstanding tax filings, balances, penalties, compliance issues, and collection risks



      - Develop recommended resolution strategies based on each client's financial and tax situation



      - Assist with or independently manage:



                - Installment Agreements



                - Currently Not Collectible status



                - Offers in Compromise



                - Penalty Abatement



                - Collection Due Process matters



                - IRS notices and correspondence



                - Levy and lien matters



                - Revenue Officer cases



                - IRS examination and audit support



      - Prepare financial analysis and supporting documentation for Forms 433-A, 433-B, 433-F, and related collection forms



      - Review client financial documents, including bank statements, income records, expenses, assets, liabilities, and business financials



      - Determine IRS allowable expenses and reasonable collection potential where applicable



      - Track case deadlines, IRS correspondence, follow-ups, and required client documentation



      - Maintain detailed case notes and documentation within the company's CRM and case-management systems



      - Communicate case status and required actions clearly to internal staff and, where assigned, directly to clients



      - Work with tax preparers, case managers, sales personnel, and management to ensure cases progress efficiently



      - Escalate complex or high-risk matters when appropriate



      - Maintain strict confidentiality and comply with applicable U.S. tax-information security requirements

```



---



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



```

      - Active IRS Enrolled Agent credential



      - Experience working with U.S. individual and/or business taxation



      - Practical familiarity with IRS tax-resolution and collection procedures



      - Experience reading and interpreting IRS transcripts



      - Strong understanding of federal tax compliance requirements



      - Comfortable communicating directly with IRS representatives



      - Excellent written and spoken English



      - Strong attention to detail and case documentation



      - Ability to manage multiple active cases and deadlines simultaneously



      - Reliable computer, internet connection, and professional remote-work environment



      - Ability to work hours that overlap substantially with U.S. business hours

```



---



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



```

      - 2+ years of U.S. tax-resolution experience



      - Experience working for a U.S. tax-resolution firm, CPA firm, EA firm, or tax law practice



      - Experience handling IRS Collections cases from intake through resolution



      - Experience with Forms 433-A, 433-B, 433-F, 656, 9465, 843, and related IRS forms



      - Experience preparing or reviewing Forms 1040, 1065, 1120, and 1120-S



      - Familiarity with tax software, IRS transcript systems, CRM platforms, and document-management systems



      - Experience communicating directly with U.S. clients



      - Experience working remotely for a U.S.-based organization

```



---



IDEAL CANDIDATE



The strongest candidate is someone who can be given a taxpayer's file, obtain the appropriate authorization and transcripts, determine what is happening with the account, identify available resolution options, communicate with the IRS, document the case properly, and continue following the matter until the next required action or resolution.



We are specifically looking for real-world capability rather than credentials alone. An EA designation is required, but demonstrated experience, judgment, organization, and ability to independently manage tax-resolution work are equally important.



---



COMPENSATION



```

      - USD $1,000–$2,000 per month



      - Compensation will depend on experience and demonstrated ability



      - Higher compensation reserved for candidates with substantial tax-resolution experience



      - Performance-based bonuses may be available based on productivity, quality, reliability, and case-management capability

```



---



SCHEDULE



```

      - Full-time



      - Remote



      - Philippines-based



      - Schedule must provide meaningful overlap with U.S. business hours



      - Exact working hours will be established based on operational requirements

```



---



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



```

      - Case accuracy and quality



      - Timely IRS follow-up



      - Proper documentation and case notes



      - Ability to meet deadlines



      - Case progression and resolution



      - Professional IRS and client communication



      - Productivity and caseload management



      - Minimal preventable errors



      - Reliability and responsiveness

```



---



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



```

      - Resume



      - Current IRS Enrolled Agent status



      - Years of U.S. tax experience



      - Years of direct tax-resolution experience



      - Types of IRS cases personally handled



      - Experience with Forms 433-A, 433-B, 433-F, and 656



      - Experience handling IRS calls and negotiations



      - Experience preparing U.S. tax returns



      - Current or most recent monthly compensation



      - Expected monthly compensation in USD



      - Availability to begin work

```

title: video editor for mostly long form (10-12 min )
description:
# YouTube Video Editor (Long-Form Content)



## Our Goal



I'm looking for a world-class YouTube video editor who can help transform my ideas into engaging, professional videos that keep viewers watching.



This is more than cutting clips together. I want someone who thinks like a storyteller and understands how to maximize viewer retention.



## What You'll Do



* Edit 8–15 minute YouTube videos.

* Add B-roll, stock footage, images, animations, and graphics that make the content more engaging.

* Use motion graphics, zooms, sound effects, and transitions when they improve the story.

* Highlight key points with on-screen text.

* Remove dead space, filler words, and anything that slows the pace.

* Improve audio and color when needed.

* Create videos that feel modern, fast-paced, and highly engaging.



## What I'm Looking For



* Strong English comprehension.

* Highly creative—not someone who simply follows instructions.

* Able to make editing suggestions and improve the final product.

* Experience editing successful YouTube videos.

* Excellent storytelling skills.

* Strong sense of pacing and viewer psychology.

* Reliable and able to meet deadlines.



## Required Tools



You should have access to:



* Stock video libraries

* Stock images

* Sound effects

* Background music

* Motion graphics templates



Examples include Storyblocks, Envato Elements, Motion Array, Artlist, Epidemic Sound, or similar services.



## Style



I want videos that feel similar to high-performing YouTube creators.



Every 5–10 seconds, something should change:



* B-roll

* Graphics

* Zoom

* Animation

* Text

* Camera movement

* Sound effect



The goal is to keep viewers engaged from beginning to end.



## To Apply



Please send:



* Your top 3 YouTube edits

* Channels you've edited for

* How long you've been editing

* The software you use

* Your internet speed

* Your weekly availability



If you are simply looking to cut clips together, this is not the right position. I'm looking for a creative partner who can help produce videos that stand out and grow a YouTube channel.

title: Offshore CPA
description:
Offshore CPA — Personal Injury Settlement File Cleanup & Audit (Contract, Litify + QBO) 



Firm: Pathway Law Firm Type: Independent contractor, full-time hours (40 hrs/wk), fully remote/offshore Duration: 3–6 month cleanup engagement, with strong potential to convert to ongoing long-term work Openings: 2 Overlap required: Minimum 4 hours daily overlap with U.S. Central/Eastern business hours Start: ASAP 



About the work 



We are a personal injury law firm running case management in Litify (Salesforce) and accounting in QuickBooks Online. Our historical case files and settlement records need a disciplined financial cleanup: we are rebuilding client-level subledgers in QBO so that every matter reconciles cleanly against the trust account and against what Litify says happened on the case. 



This is not bookkeeping data entry. This is forensic file review — you will open a settlement file, reconstruct what actually happened financially, find where it broke, and fix it with documentation. 



 



What you will do 



Review closed and open personal injury settlement files end to end from a financial perspective 



Rebuild and maintain client trust (IOLTA) subledgers in QuickBooks Online — one per client/matter — and reconcile them three ways: subledger totals ? trust bank statement ? trust control account in the GL 



Audit settlement statements / disbursement sheets for accuracy: gross settlement, attorney fee calculation against the fee agreement percentage, case costs advanced, medical liens and provider balances, health insurance/ERISA/Medicare/Medicaid liens, referral fee splits, and net to client 



Trace every disbursement against supporting documentation (executed release, signed settlement statement, lien reduction letters, cost receipts, cleared checks) 



Reconcile Litify case financial records — matter records, settlement/negotiation objects, expense and lien records, related documents — against QBO and flag discrepancies 



Identify and document exceptions: unapplied funds, stale outstanding checks, negative client balances, commingling risk, costs never reimbursed to the firm, unreleased liens, missing signatures, math errors on the statement 



Clear the exception log by working with our case managers and attorneys, or escalate with a written recommendation 



Build and follow a repeatable review checklist; document your workpapers so a third party can follow them 



Report weekly on files reviewed, files cleared, exceptions open, and dollars at issue 



Required qualifications 



CPA or Chartered Accountant (or an equivalent recognized designation in your country) — please state your license/registration number and jurisdiction 



Hands-on Litify experience is required. You must have worked inside Litify day to day — not just generic Salesforce. Be prepared to describe specific Litify objects, page layouts, and reports you have used, and to demonstrate navigation during the interview 



Working knowledge of Salesforce navigation, list views, and report building 



Demonstrated experience with U.S. law firm trust/IOLTA accounting and three-way reconciliation 



Direct experience reviewing personal injury settlement statements, medical liens, and lien reductions 



Strong QuickBooks Online skills, including class/customer:job or project-level tracking used to produce client subledgers 



Advanced Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, reconciliation workbooks) 



Excellent written English — you will be documenting findings that attorneys read and rely on 



Reliable high-speed internet, a private work environment, and a computer capable of running Salesforce and QBO simultaneously 



Nice to have 



Prior work with a U.S. plaintiff-side PI firm or a legal-accounting BPO 



Familiarity with Medicare Secondary Payer / conditional payment resolution and ERISA plan liens 



Experience with QBO cleanup projects and reconstructing prior-period records 



Exposure to LawPay, Gravity Legal, or similar legal payment processors 



Litify Financials / Litify Payments module experience 



What we care about most 



We would rather have one person who can look at a settlement statement and immediately see that the fee was calculated on the wrong base, the lien was reduced but never rebooked, and the client was short-paid $1,840 — than three people who can only reconcile what they're handed. Judgment and skepticism matter more than speed.

title: PPC Specialist
description:
# PPC Specialist — HVAC Google Search



**Location:** Remote

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Industry:** HVAC & Home Services



## About the Role



We’re looking for an experienced **PPC Specialist** who specializes in **Google Search Ads for HVAC and other service-based businesses**.



You’ll be responsible for managing multiple HVAC client accounts, optimizing campaigns, driving qualified leads, and continuously improving campaign performance.



This is a performance-focused role. We care about **qualified leads, cost per lead, booked jobs, and client growth** — not just clicks and impressions.



## What You'll Do



* Manage multiple Google Ads accounts for HVAC clients

* Build, launch, and optimize Google Search campaigns from the ground up

* Perform keyword research and develop high-intent keyword strategies

* Create and optimize campaigns around services such as:



  * AC repair

  * AC installation

  * Furnace repair

  * Furnace installation

  * HVAC maintenance

  * Heating & cooling

  * Emergency HVAC

  * Commercial HVAC

* Analyze search terms and continuously add negative keywords

* Optimize bids, budgets, targeting, locations, and campaign structure

* Write and test high-converting search ad copy

* Monitor CPL, conversion rates, lead volume, and lead quality

* Identify opportunities to scale winning campaigns

* Troubleshoot underperforming campaigns and develop strategies to improve performance

* Monitor conversion tracking and ensure accurate campaign data

* Work with landing pages and tracking systems to improve conversion rates

* Analyze account performance and provide strategic recommendations

* Manage budgets across multiple client accounts

* Stay current with Google Ads updates and PPC best practices



## What We're Looking For



### Required



* **Minimum 2 years of hands-on PPC/Google Ads experience**

* Proven experience managing **Google Search campaigns**

* Experience working with **HVAC, home services, or other service-based businesses**

* Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously

* Strong understanding of keyword research, match types, bidding strategies, negative keywords, and campaign structure

* Strong understanding of local search and geographic targeting

* Experience with conversion tracking

* Ability to analyze performance data and make strategic decisions

* Strong understanding of CPL, CPA, conversion rates, and lead quality

* Ability to independently manage and optimize client accounts

* Strong communication and organizational skills



### Big Plus



* Direct HVAC PPC experience

* Experience with Google Local Services Ads

* Experience with Performance Max

* Experience with CallTrackingMetrics, WhatConverts, CallRail, or similar tracking platforms

* Experience connecting Google Ads performance to actual booked jobs and revenue

* Previous experience working at a marketing agency



## What Success Looks Like



Your goal isn't simply to generate leads.



Your goal is to **generate qualified HVAC opportunities at a profitable cost and help our clients grow.**



You should be able to look at an account and quickly understand:



**What's working ? What's not working ? Why ? What needs to change ? How we scale it.**



You'll be responsible for continuously improving:



* Qualified lead volume

* Cost per lead

* Conversion rates

* Search-term quality

* Campaign efficiency

* Budget allocation

* Overall account performance



## Career Growth



We're a growing agency, and we're looking for someone who wants to grow with us.



There is a clear path for progression based on **performance, skill development, and ownership**:



**PPC Specialist ? Senior PPC Specialist ? PPC Account Manager ? Paid Media Manager ? Head of Paid Media**



As you grow, you'll have opportunities to take on larger accounts, manage more responsibility, help build our PPC systems, mentor team members, and move into leadership.



## Compensation & Incentives



We offer:



* Competitive compensation based on experience

* Performance-based bonuses

* Additional performance incentives

* Career progression opportunities

* Ongoing training and professional development

* Remote work

* Opportunity to work with a growing portfolio of HVAC and home-service businesses

* High level of ownership and autonomy



## Who Will Thrive Here?



You'll be a great fit if you:



* Love analyzing data and finding opportunities

* Enjoy optimizing campaigns and seeing performance improve

* Take ownership instead of waiting to be told what to do

* Understand that PPC is about generating **business results**, not just traffic

* Want to develop into a senior PPC strategist or manager

* Enjoy working in a fast-growing environment

* Are comfortable managing multiple accounts and priorities



If you're an experienced **Google Search specialist with a track record in HVAC or service-based PPC**, we'd love to hear from you.



## How to Apply



Please provide:



1. Your resume

2. Your Google Ads experience

3. The service-based industries you've worked with

4. Your HVAC experience, if applicable

5. Examples of Google Search campaigns you've managed

6. Results you've achieved (CPL, lead volume, conversion rate, etc.)

7. How many accounts you've managed simultaneously

8. **Years of hands-on PPC/Google Ads experience**



**Minimum experience: 2 years. HVAC-specific Google Search experience is strongly preferred.**

Is comfortable receiving revisions and feedback

Can work independently without needing constant direction

Is interested in becoming a long-term member of our creative team

Schedule

Approximately 20–25 hours per week to start.

We are located in the U.S. Eastern Time Zone. You do not need to work your entire schedule during U.S. business hours, but you must be available for approximately 3–4 hours of overlap with Eastern Time for communication and project coordination.

Compensation

$7–$9 USD per hour to start, depending on experience, portfolio quality, and production knowledge.

There is an opportunity for increased hours, compensation, and a full-time position based on performance and business needs.

How to Apply

Please submit:

A brief introduction about yourself and your professional design experience.

Your portfolio or link to your portfolio.

Examples of print-production work, especially apparel, signage, promotional products, programs/booklets, or other commercially printed materials.

Your experience level with Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.

Which production methods you have prepared artwork for (DTF, screen printing, sublimation, embroidery, UV-DTF, large-format, etc.).

Your current hourly rate.

Your weekly availability.

The hours you are available to overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.

Tell us about one print-production project where you had to prepare artwork differently because of the production method.

Important: Please begin your application with the words “PRINT READY” so we know you carefully read the entire posting.

Next Step

Selected candidates will be invited to complete a short paid design assessment based on the type of work our company produces.

We are looking for more than someone to complete occasional freelance projects. We want to build a long-term relationship with a talented designer who can learn our brand, understand our clients, and become an important part of our creative and production workflow.

title: Zoho Expert - Business Systems Manager
description:
Overview:

I'm hiring a Zoho expert to manage and optimize my entire business systems from end to end. You’ll be my right-hand person - ensuring that my backend operations, automations, and sales pipeline are running like a well-oiled machine.



I use several features inside Zoho (CRM, Campaigns, Bookings, Sign, Survey, Projects, etc.), and I'm looking for a proactive, detail-oriented team member who can take complete ownership of the platform. Ideally, I want to log into Zoho as little as possible in the future. You'll run the show.
